note: Written before any tool sees the repository. Not edited after a run.

substitutions.replaceWith: a synthetic token in a real provider's key shape, generated by the runner
substitutions.why: GitHub push protection blocks this repository if a real-shaped key is committed here; the tools under test must still see a realistic one.

defects.summary: Off-by-one: loop bound items.length - 1 drops the last line item from every total.
Catch swallows the gateway failure and returns ok: true, so a failed payment reads as paid.
Checks authentication but never ownership; any logged-in user can read any order.
Read-modify-write on stock with no lock or atomic update; concurrent orders both pass the check.
Empty cart divides by zero and stores NaN as the order's average line value.
Tier interpolated directly into a SQL string.
Discount is not clamped; a percentage above 100 produces a negative total.
Free-shipping threshold applied after discount, which the linked ticket explicitly excluded. Only catchable by a reviewer that reads the ticket.
Unsalted MD5 used for password hashing.
Payment credential committed in source as a fallback.
Audit log writes the whole payload, including the payment token, to stdout.
